---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this library
title: '[FEATURE]: '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

> _Ex: "I'm always frustrated when I have to hand-roll X to achieve Y..."_

## 💡 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the new
functionality or the change to existing behavior.

## 💻 Proposed API / Usage Example

If applicable, show how you would imagine the C++ code looking with this new
feature:

```cpp
#include <cpp_library_template/hello_world.hpp>

// How you'd like to use the new feature
auto result = cpp_library_template::new_function("example");

```

## 🌈 Use Case & Benefits

Why is this feature important to you and other users? How does it improve the
library?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds
you've considered (e.g., using a different library or a custom wrapper).

## 💥 Compatibility

Would this break existing code? Note anything that changes an existing
signature, the ABI, or a default.

- [ ] Purely additive
- [ ] Source breaking
- [ ] ABI breaking

## ⚠️ Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or links to similar implementations in other
libraries here.
